title: Why Zero
promptLanguage: Scrub one Three.js scene with a custom eased scroll value, and open it with a drawn loop that seeds a frost shader. Procedural gradients, grain, and a short hold gate carry the argument from a promise, through a break, into a city the visitor can pan.
notes: The public build is one canvas from the opening stroke to a pannable city, with hold gates between stages and type composited after the grade. Wheel and touch feed a virtual scroll value, and GSAP, shaders, and Howler ride that number rather than a document scroller.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion shows the stages as still frames in order, skips the hold gates and the render loop, and leaves sound off.
creditLine: Sindhur Dutta, Zero Design, Atul Khola, Why Zero (https://thefwa.com/cases/why-zero)
